threats.title: THREAT-09 Resource exhaustion
threats.description:
Repeated costly queries exhaust worker or database capacity and interrupt record and public-service access.
R-09 / TVA-09 / A-02; A-04
Secondary STRIDE: Denial of service
threats.mitigation: Rate and concurrency limits, capped pagination/body size, timeouts and bounded queries. ACL-09 / SEC-09

threats.title: THREAT-01 SQL injection
threats.description:
If search concatenates input, a crafted query can bypass record filtering and disclose nonpublic research metadata. Successful SQL injection depends on the actual query and database grants.
R-01 / TVA-01 / A-02
Secondary STRIDE: Tampering; Information disclosure
threats.mitigation: Parameterized SQL, publication filter, least-privilege DB role, regression test. ACL-01 / SEC-01

threats.title: THREAT-02 Object authorization bypass
threats.description:
A user changes a record ID and reads another research team’s nonpublic record or service request. Client-hidden links do not enforce authorization.
R-02 / TVA-02 / A-02; A-03
Secondary STRIDE: Information disclosure; Elevation of privilege
threats.mitigation: Central object permission check using approved collaborator/staff grants; deny by default. ACL-02 / SEC-02

threats.title: THREAT-07 Unsafe document processing
threats.description:
If uploads are enabled, a malicious file exploits a vulnerable parser or unsafe execution path, giving a runtime foothold. A PDF extension or polyglot alone does not execute code.
R-07 / TVA-07 / A-02
Secondary STRIDE: Tampering; Elevation of privilege
threats.mitigation: Defer upload route until confirmed; then isolated patched parser, size/type checks, quarantine, no execution. ACL-07 / SEC-07

threats.title: THREAT-10 Stored browser script
threats.description:
Stored content executes when another user views a record. It may perform same-origin actions; HttpOnly cookies cannot be read directly by script.
R-10 / TVA-10 / A-02; A-01
Secondary STRIDE: Tampering; Information disclosure
threats.mitigation: Render plain text by default; approved sanitization for necessary rich text; CSP as added protection. ACL-10 / SEC-10

threats.title: THREAT-05 Missing database isolation
threats.description:
A missed application permission check exposes rows across research groups. Missing RLS is a defense gap, not by itself proof that a user can query the database.
R-05 / TVA-05 / A-02
Secondary STRIDE: Information disclosure; Elevation of privilege
threats.mitigation: RLS or equivalent tested isolation; transaction-local trusted identity; no owner/superuser/BYPASSRLS runtime. ACL-05 / SEC-05

threats.title: THREAT-08 Database extortion
threats.description:
An attacker reaches the DB, gains sufficient privileges, and corrupts or extracts research records. Permanent loss also requires unavailable or compromised recovery copies.
R-08 / TVA-08 / A-02
Secondary STRIDE: Denial of service; Tampering; Information disclosure
threats.mitigation: Private DB ingress, separate runtime/migration roles, backup credentials isolated, immutable recovery copy and restore tests. ACL-08 / SEC-08

data.name:

A-07
data.description: audit_logs in same PostgreSQL database. Runtime SELECT/INSERT only; admin can modify.

threats.title: THREAT-11 Unattributable record changes
threats.description:
An editor changes a research stage then denies doing it; writable or missing logs prevent reliable reconstruction.
R-11 / TVA-11 / A-07; A-02
Secondary STRIDE: Repudiation; Tampering
threats.mitigation: Server-derived actor and event IDs, protected append-only audit path, restricted readers, integrity monitoring. ACL-11 / SEC-11

threats.title: THREAT-03 Public private-data export
threats.description:
An operator accidentally publishes a research export. Anyone with its URL can obtain nonpublic records; encryption at rest does not stop an authorized public read.
R-03 / TVA-03 / A-02
Secondary STRIDE: Information disclosure
threats.mitigation: Private storage policy, public-access block, expiring authorized downloads, configuration tests. ACL-03 / SEC-03

threats.title: THREAT-04 Committed credentials
threats.description:
A repository reader obtains a secret and impersonates a service if network access and credential permissions permit. Removing the file alone does not revoke a leaked secret.
R-04 / TVA-04 / A-05; A-02
Secondary STRIDE: Spoofing; Information disclosure; Elevation of privilege
threats.mitigation: Secret scan on commits and CI, rotation and revocation, scoped service credentials, required review. ACL-04 / SEC-04

threats.title: THREAT-06 Session interception
threats.description:
A victim uses an insecure session path and an observer obtains a usable session. Ordinary Wi-Fi visibility does not decrypt correctly validated HTTPS.
R-06 / TVA-06 / A-01; A-02
Secondary STRIDE: Spoofing; Information disclosure
threats.mitigation: HTTPS, HSTS after validation, Secure/HttpOnly cookies, suitable SameSite and CSRF protection, rotation on login. ACL-06 / SEC-06
